description: Use when you need a crypto token price or market data for a Base token, quoted from on-chain liquidity. Do not use for tokens that only trade off Base or on other DEXs (Aerodrome is not read), price history or OHLC. Returns JSON with the USD price of a token on Base computed on-chain from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, with pool, fee tier and depth for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 1200 ms (p95). Category: Trading. Price: US$0.003 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).
